extracted.intended_audience: legal practitioners, regulated entities, CFPB staff, and members of the public seeking CFPB regulatory requirements and procedures
extracted.subtask_description: Table of contents for 12 CFR Chapter X (Consumer Financial Protection Bureau) listing parts, subparts, sections, appendices, and supplements that set forth regulatory standards, procedural rules, and model forms across CFPB authorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authority and purpose
rubrics_metrics.description: Sections titled 'Authority, purpose, and scope' (e.g., § 1001.1; § 1003.1; § 1004.1; many other parts list a similar section).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These headings indicate that each part contains an explicit statement of the statutory authority for the rules, the purpose of the part, and the scope of application. No further text provided on this TOC page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definitions
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each part typically defines terms used in that part; the TOC only lists the presence of a definitions section.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclosure and reporting requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Headings such as 'Disclosure and reporting' or 'Disclosure requirements' (e.g., § 1003.5; § 1030.3; § 1030.4; § 1009.3).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates substantive disclosure duties imposed on covered entities; the TOC provides no detailed text here.

rubrics_metrics.name: Model forms, model clauses, and appendices
rubrics_metrics.description: Multiple parts include Appendices and Model Forms (e.g., Appendix B to Part 1003, Appendix A to Part 1013, Appendix A to Part 1010, Appendices throughout Parts 1022, 1024, 1026, 1030, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presence of model forms and clauses indicates standard-prescribed formats for disclosures and notices; the TOC lists which parts include model forms/appendices but not their content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enforcement and record retention
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These headings signal duties around compliance monitoring, record retention obligations, and enforcement provisions; TOC only identifies existence of such sections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Special rules of practice — Filing assistance
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identifies a subpart that governs assistance for filings (procedural support for parties filing with the Bureau). No further procedural text shown on the TOC.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rulemaking and Guidance — Use of Supervisory Guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Part 1074, Subpart B: 'Use of Supervisory Guidance' (1074.2–1074.3).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies that the Bureau has rules on rulemaking and guidance and includes a subpart addressing the use and role of supervisory guidance; TOC includes Appendix A: 'Statement Clarifying the Role of Supervisory Guidance.' The page does not include the substance of those clarifications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statement clarifying the role of supervisory guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix A to Part 1074: 'Statement Clarifying the Role of Supervisory Guidance.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Appendix indicates the Bureau provides an explicit statement clarifying how supervisory guidance is intended to be used; TOC only names the appendix.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclosure of records and information / FOIA
rubrics_metrics.description: Part 1070, Subpart B: 'Freedom of Information Act' (1070.10–1070.23) and related disclosure provisions (1070.1–1070.5 etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identifies the Bureau's FOIA procedures and general disclosure/definitions subparts; the TOC lists the sections but not the procedural details (timelines, exemptions, request procedures).

rubrics_metrics.name: Rule implementing Equal Access to Justice Act procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Part 1071: 'Rule Implementing Equal Access to Justice Act' including 'Information Required from Applicants' (1071.200–1071.203) and 'Procedures for Considering Applications' (1071.300–1071.309).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates procedural requirements and information to be supplied for EAJA applications; the TOC only shows the section headings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedures for Bureau debt collection
rubrics_metrics.description: Part 1073: 'Procedures for Bureau Debt Collection' with subparts on scope/definitions, administrative offset, salary offset, administrative wage garnishment, and tax refund offset (1073.101 – 1073.501).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identifies the procedural mechanisms the Bureau uses to collect debts; the TOC does not provide the substantive rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consumer Financial Civil Penalty Fund rules — allocation and reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Part 1075 (1075.100–1075.110) addressing scope, definitions, fund administrator, eligible victims, payments, allocation of funds, reporting requirements, and when payments are impracticable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies organizational and procedural rules for the CFPB Civil Penalty Fund (eligibility, allocation, reporting) — TOC lists headings only.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rules relating to investigations and civil investigative demands
rubrics_metrics.description: Part 1080 (1080.1–1080.14) covering initiating and conducting investigations, notification of purpose, civil investigative demands, investigational hearings, withholding requested material, rights of witnesses, noncompliance with CIDs, and confidential treatment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identifies the Bureau's investigative procedures and protections; the TOC lists the section titles but not substantive standards or processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rules of practice for adjudication proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: Part 1081 (1081.100–1081.502) with subparts for general rules, initiation and prehearing rules, hearings, decision and appeals, and temporary cease-and-desist proceedings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates procedural rules governing adjudications before the Bureau, including prehearing and hearing procedures and decision/appeal mechanics; TOC provides only the structure/headings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedures for supervisory designation proceedings (time limits and determination procedures)
rubrics_metrics.description: Part 1091 (1091.100–1091.115) including general provisions, determination and voluntary consent procedures, post-determination procedures, and time limits and deadlines (1091.114–1091.115).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shows the Bureau sets procedures and timeframes for supervisory designation; TOC does not include substantive timelines or standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Privacy, opt-out notices, and limits on disclosures
rubrics_metrics.description: Part 1016 (1016.1–1016.17) with subparts on privacy and opt-out notices, limits on disclosures, exceptions, relation to other laws, and model privacy form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates privacy notice requirements and disclosure limits under Regulation P; TOC lists sections and appendices without providing the substantive text.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provisions requiring model clauses and sample forms for consumer financial protections
rubrics_metrics.description: Multiple parts reference model clauses, sample forms, and illustrative documents (e.g., Appendices to Parts 1003, 1005, 1024, 1026, 1030, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The TOC indicates the presence of standardized language/forms that regulated parties must use in certain contexts, but does not include the forms themselves.

rubrics_metrics.name: Record retention and advertising requirements for specific consumer protections
rubrics_metrics.description: Section headings across parts (e.g., § 1014.5 recordkeeping; § 1013.7 advertising; § 1013.8 record retention) indicating required retention and advertising standards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Marks where the CFR sets recordkeeping and advertising rules; TOC only presents the headings, not the substantive retention periods or advertising prohibitions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendices providing official interpretations and supplements
rubrics_metrics.description: Many parts include 'Supplement I', 'Official Interpretations', and 'Issuance of Official Interpretations' (e.g., Supplement I to Part 1002, 1003, 1005, 1013, 1024, 1026, 1030, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates that the Bureau provides official interpretive guidance and commentary for several regulations; the TOC signals their existence but not content.
